notes.title: [ATTENTION! Old Save File Warning] Patch V. 1.02 Coming 12-12-16
notes.content:
*IMPORTANT NOTE: When the game is updated your old save file will no longer be playable. This is due to new additions not being readable during the loading of old games. You will have until December 12th to beat the game if you want to do so before the update.

I've tried several times to find a way to make it work with the old files and it's just not working. That's why I'm giving everyone who is already progressing in the game time to complete it before I update it. The patch is very important to fix bugs and areas that are flawed so it's a must.

Thanks

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
The Patch fixing many bugs and improving features will be launched before the end of the year. The main issue which has halted the patch is that the update corrupts the original save file making it unplayable. If that error gets fixed soon it will be patched immediately. If not then I will patch it regardless at the end of the year with a reminder of the save file corruption. That's a friendly warning now so you have until the end of the year to complete game without the issue affecting you. I will continue to work on getting the patch out and improving the game.

The patch will include:

An alternative firing button for gamepads.
Various bug fixes.
Developer Error fixes like the area you can get stuck in in the "Security Area"
